name: Nyashka
summary: The term "няшка" is Russian internet slang for "cutie" or "adorable person," derived from the Japanese onomatopoeia " nya " (にゃ), the sound a cat makes, combined with the Russian diminutive suffix " -shka ," giving the word an intimate and affectionate register common in Russian naming conventions.
